A three-panel illustration showing different classifications of farm labour. Left panel: A man, woman, and teenage boy (family labour) working on a small yam farm with hoes. Middle panel: A casual, unskilled labourer manually weeding a farm with a cutlass, receiving daily wages in cash from a farmer. Right panel: A skilled, permanent worker in a clean uniform operating a modern tractor, representing hired skilled labour.

A scene on a commercial poultry farm showing farm supervision. A farm manager holding a clipboard and wearing a protective coat is observing and talking to an attendant who is distributing feed into feeding troughs for layer chickens. The manager is pointing at the feed level to guide the attendant.
